caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, dark-colored wooden chest or cabinet with two drawers. The cabinet is decorated with painted figures and nature scenes. The front of each drawer features painted scenes with people, trees, and animals. On the top drawer, there are trees, birds, and two animals resembling deer, with three human figures shown walking or standing, and a structure with columns visible to the right. The lower drawer also shows trees and features three human figures in old-fashioned clothing. Each drawer has a prominent, decorative, and symmetrical brass or golden keyhole plate in the center. The side panels of the chest display floral or leafy patterns painted in muted brown and green tones. The cabinet sits against a plain, light beige background. The overall color palette consists of dark browns, greens, reds, and subtle golds, with the depictions on the chest rendered in a muted and understated manner.
title: Jewel Cabinet
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
